text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT 5609 — Org 2401 experiencing sustained QPS spike on /v1/generate. Auto-org-throttle applied (30 QPS). Errors rising (502/504), latency > 3s. Pager: @oncall-maria. Severity: P2. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/5609. Please triage and propose mitigations.

oncall-maria: Acked. I'm looking at the traces & host metrics. Spikes started ~5609869000. Will take lead — may need an org-specific bump.

alex_ops: I see backend host pool3 overloaded, CPU + NVME IO high. Autoscaler didn't spin up new nodes because of an image pull race. Quick mitigation: per-org quota bump to allow them to complete work from dedicated pool, plus enable burst tokens.

erin_cs: Customer on a call; they're business-critical (payment flows). Please do whatever is safe.

jec_sre: Recommending temporary quota bump + traffic-shaping route to dedicated inference pool (pool-ded-5). If we bump without routing, we'll hammer shared pool.

alex_ops: Proposed commands:
```bash
# route org to dedicated pool and bump qps
rwdctl org route set --org 2401 --pool pool-ded-5 --reason "emergency spike 5609"
rwdctl org-quota set --org 2401 --qps 60 --burst 120 --reason "emergency spike 2026-03-17"
```

oncall-maria: Running route change now. Will post outputs.

incident-bot: Audit log queued: action=org.route.change org=2401 actor=oncall-maria ts=5609872001

oncall-maria: route update complete: OK.
Command output:
"routing: org 2401 -> pool-ded-5 (applied)"

oncall-maria: quota bump command:
`rwdctl org-quota set --org 2401 --qps 60 --burst 120 --reason "emergency spike"`
Output: OK — quota=60 qps, burst=120 applied at 5609872054.

alex_ops: Great. I'm enabling a short-lived circuit that will prefer cached responses for repeat prefixes (should cut tokens). Patch snippet (already applied on pool-ded-5):
```json
{"prefix_cache":true, "cache_ttl_s":60}
```

jec_sre: Monitoring metrics: error_rate dropped from 14% -> 3% over last 5m, avg latency 1.2s. CPU on pool-ded-5 at 65%. Keep an eye on concurrency.

erin_cs: Customer confirmed errors decreased and flows resumed. They asked about ETA for normal behavior.

oncall-maria: I'll watch for 30m. If stable at 30m we'll roll back routing + set a safe lower QPS (30). Handoff to night SRE @taylor_sre at 02:30 UTC if still active.

jec_sre: Reminder: create post-incident ticket with root cause (image pull race -> autoscale failure) and action items: fix image pull concurrency, add autoscaler fallback, document per-org manual bump procedure.

oncall-maria: Created ticket: INT-5609 in backlog. Link: https://redwood.internal/INT-5609. Assigned to eng-infra.

incident-bot: Policy log: org-quota-change actor=oncall-maria org=2401 prev_qps=30 new_qps=60 reason="emergency spike" ts=5609872054

erin_cs: Thank you all. Customer rep asked for a note about time window — please cc me on the postmortem.

oncall-maria: Will do. Final ops note: rollback command (if we need to revert quickly):
`rwdctl org-quota set --org 2401 --qps 30 --reason "rollback after mitigation"`

alex_ops: Also note the routing rollback: `rwdctl org route set --org 2401 --pool shared --reason "rollback after mitigation"`

oncall-maria: Marking incident monitored. Handoff scheduled to @taylor_sre at 5609881800 UTC. :thumbsup:

taylor_sre: Acked, will pick up at handoff time.

jec_sre: Thanks team — will follow up with doc + CI test for autoscaler image-pull fallback.

incident-bot: INCIDENT 5609 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closed? No, monitoring window active (30m).
